kidDefinition.en: A round, crunchy fruit that can be red, green, or yellow.
kidDefinition.zh: 一种又圆又脆的水果，有红色的、绿色的或黄色的。

exampleSentence.en: I love eating a crunchy red apple!
exampleSentence.zh: 我喜欢吃脆生生的红苹果！

kidDefinition.en: A small, furry pet with whiskers that likes to say meow.
kidDefinition.zh: 一只长着胡须、喜欢喵喵叫的毛茸茸小宠物。

exampleSentence.en: The soft cat is sleeping in the sun.
exampleSentence.zh: 柔软的小猫正睡在太阳底下。

kidDefinition.en: The big, bright yellow star in the sky that keeps us warm.
kidDefinition.zh: 天空中又大又亮、给我们温暖的黄色大恒星。

exampleSentence.en: The sun is shining brightly today!

kidDefinition.en: Pages with words and colorful pictures that tell a story.
kidDefinition.zh: 有文字和彩色图画、能讲故事的一页页书本。

exampleSentence.en: Open your storybook and read with me!
exampleSentence.zh: 打开你的故事书，和我一起读吧！

kidDefinition.en: The pretty color of the ocean and the clear sky.
kidDefinition.zh: 大海和晴朗天空的漂亮颜色。

exampleSentence.en: Look at the little blue bird in the tree.
exampleSentence.zh: 看树上那只蓝色的小鸟。
